snippet.title: Next Time... I'll work from home. (Gameplay Trailer)
snippet.description:
Eric Stokes, a 27-year-old office clerk, finally found a new job after a long unemployment. As a new father, he eagerly starts his new job, but quickly finds that something about this office is off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5189940/Next_time_Ill_work_from_home/
